pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and managed-services leader across five industry groups with record bookings ($72.2B in FY23); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30. Accenture's own FY2023 10-K says 'Examples of areas of significant change include digital-, cloud- and security-related offerings, which are continually evolving, as well as developments in areas such as AI, including generative AI ... Some of these technological developments have reduced and replaced some of our historical services and solutions and will continue to do so in the future. ... the introduction of new technologies (such as generative AI), services or products by competitors could reduce our ability to obtain favorable pricing' It reported generative AI new bookings of over $900 million in the quarter, $2 billion fiscal year-to-date (Q3 FY24). The stock trades at 28.2x FY24E — a premium. Re-file under DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) when the multiple falls to a discount to its own history (30th percentile or lower) or managed-services growth drops below 3% LC.

Live: Accenture's own FY2023 10-K says 'Examples of areas of significant change include digital-, cloud- and security-related offerings, which are continually evolving, as well as developments in areas such as AI, including generative AI, augmented and virtual reality, automation, blockchain, Internet of Things, quantum and edge computing, infrastructure and network engineering, intelligent connected products, digital engineering and manufacturing, and robotics solutions. ... Some of these technological developments have reduced and replaced some of our historical services and solutions and will continue to do so in the future.' At the same time it reports 'growing demand to assist clients with application modernization and maintenance, cloud enablement and cybersecurity-as-a-service (formerly managed security services)'. The stock trades at 28.2x FY24E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of ACN's outsourcing specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and managed-services leader across five industry groups with record bookings ($72.2B in FY23); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.55x; +48% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.50; conservative 2yr -5%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY13-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.7%/yr (FY13-FY23 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +19.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY23); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2024-09-20) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.55x (31.3% downside to Bear $231 / +20.2% upside to Bull $404) | Adj composite 1.77 vs market 3.27: gap -1.50 [OVERVALUED] | +48% above the EPP floor $227 (19x FY24E $11.93) | Conservative 2-yr case: -5.2% total (-2.6%/yr) | At 28.2x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $445 sits above the BULL case; consulting -1% LC in Q3, Q4 guided +2-6% LC; GenAI is live and company-acknowledged (10-K FY23), but the multiple does not discount it.
